reviews.text: This makeup product has a smooth and lightweight texture that is easy to apply. It provides natural-looking coverage with a long-lasting finish. The formula feels comfortable on the skin and blends evenly. The packaging is simple and practical for daily use. Overall, it is a reliable choice for creating a polished makeup look.
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝品質地順滑輕盈，易於搽抹。佢提供自然嘅遮蓋效果，而且持久。配方搽喺皮膚上感覺舒服，推勻得好平均。包裝簡單又實用，適合日常使用。整體嚟講，係一款可靠嘅選擇，可以打造出精緻嘅妝容。

reviews.text:
Photo taken after 10 hours of wear in Florida humidity and heat (~80F).

My only issue with it is that if you apply over an area you already applied eyeliner on.. it removes the original layer. Not sure if that’s an issue with liquid eyeliner in general or if it’s this brand.
reviews.zh:
呢張相係喺佛羅里達嘅潮濕同酷熱天氣（約 80°F）下，持妝 10 小時後拍嘅。

我唯一嘅問題係，如果你喺已經畫咗眼線嘅位置再搽，就會將原本嗰層除走。我唔肯定呢個係咪所有液態眼線都有嘅問題，定係呢個品牌先有嘅問題。

reviews.text:
La picmentación y precisión del lapis son muy buenas.
Mientras no lo toques es aprueba de todo, incluso puedes meterte a bañar y a salir va a estar intacto.
En el video se puede ver que incluso después de varias horas en un día caluroso resiste.
reviews.zh:
呢支筆嘅顯色度同精準度都好好。
只要你唔郁佢，佢就防得住一切，甚至可以去沖涼，出嚟都仲係完好無缺。
影片入面可以睇到，即使喺炎熱嘅日子捱咗幾個鐘，佢都保持得住。

reviews.text: Got the brown and it glides easily on my eyes giving it a very sleek look. The color is pigmented however it doesn’t last on me. I find that it smudge at the end of the day. Maybe it’s because I have oily eyelids. However, I still use it as I love the color.
reviews.zh: 我買咗啡色，搽喺眼上好滑，睇落好利落時尚。顏色好有顯色度，不過喺我身上冇咁耐。我發現到咗晚上會暈開。可能係因為我眼皮出油。不過，我仍然會用，因為我好鍾意個顏色。

reviews.text: ALMOST as good as my ride or die liner from NYX, but still incredible lasting power! my eyes tend to water a lot because they get dry easily but this liner didnt budge until like 12+ hours in! it even survived a nap! it's also just a really nice shade of brown
reviews.zh: 差唔多好似我最死忠嘅 NYX 眼線咁好，但係持久力依然好勁！我嘅眼睛好容易流眼水，因為好容易乾，但係呢支眼線到咗十二幾個鐘都冇暈開！仲可以瞓咗個午覺都冇事！個棕色都真係好靚。

reviews.text: Good eyeliner, comparing with others it has a longer and better form brush, easier to apply and lasts quite a while. Easy to clean with a cleansing balm as it melts it away without leaving residues. The double pack is handy. I like it.
reviews.zh: 好嘅眼線。同其他產品比較，佢嘅筆頭長啲、形狀都好啲，易搽，持久力都幾好。用卸妝膏好易清除，佢會溶解掉，唔會留低殘留物。雙裝都好方便。我好鍾意。

reviews.text:
I wasn’t sure about this one at first because it bled a lot the first time I tried it and flaked off my eyes so weirdly. 

But after trying it a few times and storing it with the tip up (first time I’ve ever done that with an eyeliner…), it’s been so much better. It never transfers during the day but WILL flake off if you touch it directly including if you curl your lashes after applying! If you don’t touch it though it is bulletproof.
reviews.zh:
一開始我都唔太肯定呢款，因為我第一次用嗰陣暈咗好多，而且喺眼皮上好奇怪咁起片脫落。

但係試過幾次，又試過將佢筆尖朝上咁放（呢個係我第一次對眼線筆咁做……），之後就好多。日間都唔會轉印，但係如果你直接郁到佢，包括搽完眼線之後夾睫毛，都一定會起片！如果你唔郁佢，就好堅固、好穩陣。

reviews.text: Don't waste your money. I used to love thier eyeliners but this one is totally useless. After 2 uses, it dried our completely. I'm not even joking. Waste of money.
reviews.zh: 唔好浪費金錢。我以前好鍾意佢哋嘅眼線，但係呢款完全冇用。用咗兩次之後，佢就完全乾晒。我冇講笑。浪費錢。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
